_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: List the providers the resolver supports...

description: Use this to see which drives and social platforms resolve_share_link supports before calling it, or when the user asks which links work. Returns one record per provider (id, kind, hosts, link examples, the public interface read, auth need, whether a direct URL is returned, last verified date) and the rules every adapter keeps.
name: list_share_providers

auth_need.description: What the person needs for a direct download: nothing, the share code, or their own sign-in.

direct_download.description: True when the web tool and MCP return a direct URL; false when they only list the files.

endpoint.description: The provider's public interface the adapter reads.

kind.description: drive: the link holds files, which the answer lists. social: a post or video link, which the answer turns into its canonical URL.

last_verified.description: The day a real public link last resolved through this adapter (YYYY-MM-DD).

title: List the providers the resolver supports
